model: Simple Step Thru FAT Tire 3 Wheel Electric
description:
Introducing the Simple Step Through 3 Wheel Electric Bike for Adults; a safe, stable, comfortable and powerful electric tricycle. This step through e tricycle for adults has all of the bells and whistles and even more. There's never been another e trike for adults like this before.

Featuring a 750 watt Bafang Front Hub motor this e trike can reach speeds of up 16mph and propel riders up to 350lbs. The 15ah battery will power the motor for up to 50 miles on a single charge. Mounting and dismounting of this e tricycle is easier than any other electric trike in existence. The step through height is a mere 11 inches allowing riders 4'9" to 6'4" to ride this electric trike for adults.

Five levels of pedal assist are available as riders need them. Level five of the pedal assist will boost you up hills in a flash. There is also a thumb throttle that can be used when your legs are tired and you want this extraordinary three wheeled ebike to do all the work. Press the throttle and instantly you are off zooming with no effort of your own.

You will not find another electric tricycle for adults that has the number of features the Simple Step Through Electric Tricycle Bike has.

750 Watt Bafang Front Hub Motor That Powers Riders Up Hills & Top Speeds of 16mph

Rear Differential that Stabilizes the Rear Wheels and Creates a Safe Balanced Ride

11" Step Over Height for Easy Mounting and Dismounting

Ergonomic, Upright Riding Position to Reduce Strain on Back, Hips, Shoulders, and Knees

3 Tektro Disc Brakes, 1 in front, 2 in Rear for "Stop on a Dime" Braking Power

Huge Rear Cargo Basket and Custom Basket Bags Options Available (Sold Separately)

Optional Rear Seat Available (Sold Separately) to Bring Passengers on Rides

The advanced rear differential on this 3 wheel ebike ensures power is distributed evenly to both rear wheels when pedaling. Turns on this e trike are smooth as butter and balanced. Both wheels in the rear will be getting power gluing the wheels to ground with unbelievable traction. Ultimately making turns on this 3 wheeled electric bike incredible safe and stable.

State-of-the-Art Rear Differential that Stabilizes the Rear Wheels and Creates a Safe Balanced Ride

Take Turns Knowing the Traction Will be Amazing Around Corners

All Three Tires Stayed Glued to Riding Surface

Ride Through Grass and Trails Easily with Both Rear Wheels Receiving Power
